categories.name: Look

categories.name: World life
categories.description: Interiors you walk into, shops, street food, extra props and map fixes.

categories.name: Driving
categories.description: Car camera, car fixes and tuning.

categories.name: Combat & camera

categories.name: Paid: buy to enable
categories.description: Paid mods from your own sources. Tick one once you own it; Leonida never uses a re-upload.

categories.name: Either / or
categories.description: Other mods from your videos. Each one takes the place of a pack mod that does the same job, so the two never run together.

addons.name: VisualV (free look)
addons.description: The best free look for GTA V Enhanced: weather, lighting and colour from Los Angeles photos; no ReShade, light on older GPUs. The free stand-in for the paid NVE. Game build 1.0.1158.13 or newer only: on 1.0.1013.20 it draws grid lines over the screen.

addons.name: Prime Realism V
addons.description: GTA VI-style physically based sky and volumetric clouds; needs ReShade, heavy on older GPUs, early Enhanced build.

addons.name: MaxedV
addons.description: Timecycle and weather overhaul; Enhanced alpha port.

addons.name: Open GTA Online interiors
addons.description: Switches on the game's own online interiors in story mode, mostly at their real places.

addons.name: Walk-in shops and diners
addons.description: Seamless Burger Shot, Up-n-Atom and two 24/7 interiors built into the map, like GTA VI's open shops.

addons.name: Map Updates
addons.description: Unused and restored map details by the Map Fixes author (optional seasonal props).

addons.name: Extra trees and props
addons.description: GTA V Remastered: thousands of extra trees, bushes and props. Heavy on older GPUs.

addons.name: Street food vendors
addons.description: Buy food from the street carts.

addons.name: Jason Duval's house
addons.description: An add-on house interior (alpha).

addons.name: Dynamic first-person car camera
addons.description: A first-person car camera that moves with the road and your head.

addons.name: Vehicle fixes
addons.description: Fixes model, texture and light errors on hundreds of the game's own cars (358 MB).

addons.name: Benny's Motor Works
addons.description: Benny's custom shop in story mode.

addons.name: Immersive Combat
addons.description: Weapon handling and damage closer to GTA VI's trailers; install after NextGen Euphoria.

addons.name: GTA VI camera flinch
addons.description: A camera shake when you get hit.

addons.name: Better fist fighting
addons.description: Longer, more even fist fights.

addons.name: ActionsV
addons.description: Smoke, drink, play guitar, binoculars and more.

addons.name: Food delivery and rideshare jobs
addons.description: Deliver food and drive passengers for money.

addons.name: Jason & Lucia heads (free)
addons.description: Two reshaped freemode heads plus Menyoo outfits; may need CodeWalker's conversion on Enhanced. Untested.

addons.name: GTA VI loading screens
addons.description: FBICat's GTA VI loading screens with Rockstar's Vice City pictures (the HUD's own add-on).

addons.name: Modern phone icons
addons.description: iOS 26-style app icons on the iFruit phone, closer to GTA VI's modern smartphone.

addons.name: AuraV Lite path tracing (NVIDIA RTX)
addons.description: Free path-traced light, shadows and reflections, a new sky and clouds. NVIDIA RTX cards only; untested together with VisualV.

addons.name: Fresh road textures (Forza Horizon 6 Roads)
addons.description: New asphalt, crosswalks and sidewalks made from scratch; works with VisualV.

addons.name: NaturalVision Enhanced (paid)
addons.description: The graphics overhaul in 4 of your 5 videos (Razed's Patreon). With it Drive V comes in its NVE package (Drive V for NVE).

addons.name: Lively World Expansion (paid)
addons.description: The world expansion in all 5 of your videos (LWE team's Patreon). It takes GTA V Remastered's place: both plant trees in the same spots.

addons.name: Jason and Lucia models (paid)
addons.description: The player models from INTER's video (the creator's Patreon shop).

addons.name: GTA IV handling instead of Drive V
addons.description: Liberty Suspension + Liberty Damage (INTER's video). Drive V is left out while this is on.

addons.name: NVE + DLC car traffic (paid)
addons.description: DLC Vehicle Traffic Popgroups (INTER's video) needs NVE's onigiri folder, so this choice brings NVE (paid) with it. Replaces Traffic V. Game build 1.0.1158.13 or newer.

addons.name: Downtown Cab Co. taxis
addons.description: New taxis (INTER's video). Its Taxi takes the place of the Vehicle Fixes pack's.

addons.name: Fuel Reloaded instead of the HUD's fuel
addons.description: INTER's fuel mod. The GTA VI HUD's own fuel is switched off while this is on.

addons.name: Immersive weapon sounds
addons.description: El chino's sound pack (Project VI's video). Replaces the game's weapon sounds; nothing clashes.

packs.name: Leonida Core
packs.description: The free, stable base: GTA VI-Inspired HUD, combat camera, Drive V, NextGen Euphoria, MP cars in traffic, Map Fixes and Bugstar Fixes. One mod per job, nothing paid.

packs.name: Leonida Plus
packs.description: Core plus the safe extras: Immersive Combat, the game's own online interiors (Enable All Interiors with LemonUI) and the Jason Duval House alpha.

variants.name: Performance
variants.description: For cards without ray tracing, like a GTX 1060 / 1070 or RX 580: author-default densities, no extra car models, ray-tracing memory off in Resource Extensions.

variants.name: Balanced
variants.description: Livelier streets: 1.5x people and parked cars, 1.25x traffic (game build 1.0.1158.13 or newer), longer-lasting decals, a few more car models at once.

variants.name: Ultra
variants.description: RT-capable cards with 12 GB+ of video memory: 2x people and parked cars, 1.5x traffic (game build 1.0.1158.13 or newer), 5 extra MP cars at once, longest decals, low-priority props.

packs.name: Leonida Max (RTX 50)
packs.description: Plus and Better Vehicle Deformation, for NVIDIA RTX 50-series GPUs.

packs.name: Leonida Showcase (GTA VI)
packs.description: Everything that brings the free game closest to GTA VI: Plus, GTA V Remastered, Map Updates, the walk-in Burger Shot / Up-n-Atom / 24/7 shops, street food, Benny's, ActionsV, the camera flinch, the dynamic first-person car camera and side jobs.

variants.name: Performance

variants.name: Balanced

variants.name: Ultra
variants.description: RT-capable cards with 12 GB+ of video memory: 2x people and parked cars, 1.5x traffic (game build 1.0.1158.13 or newer), 5 extra MP cars at once, longest decals, low-priority props.

packs.name: Leonida (owner's pick)
packs.description: Only the mods from your own sources (the TGG, Project VI and INTER videos and the LWE public release), plus the tools they need. Where two of them do the same job, the one your videos use most stays (docs/OWNER-SOURCES.md says which). Paid ones are add-ons you tick once you own them.

variants.name: 16 GB of RAM
variants.description: For PCs with 16 GB: Resource Extensions keeps the game's own streaming, car-model and ray-tracing memory budgets, and normal crowds. Looks the same on cards without ray tracing; on the owner's 16 GB PC the full pack loaded every time once about 6 GB was free.

variants.name: 32 GB of RAM
variants.description: For PCs with 32 GB or more: doubled streaming budgets, more car models at once, Resource Extensions' extra ray-tracing memory, and fuller streets (game build 1.0.1158.13 or newer).
